data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




As an AMD intern and co-op, you’ll be placed at the epicenter of the AI ecosystem, working alongside experts and industry pioneers. You’ll do important work, learn new skills, expand your network, and gain real-world experience on projects that impact millions of end-users worldwide. Whether you’re an undergrad or a PhD student, your contributions matter—and your experience here will be a launchpad for what comes next.

 

JOB DETAILS:

  • Location: San Jose, CA or Santa Clara,CA
  • Onsite: This role requires the student to work full time (40 hours a week), onsite work structure throughout the duration of the co-op/intern term

  • Duration:

    • Spring/Summer Co-op: January 25, 2027 - August 13, 2027
    • Summer Internship:

data.responsibilities:
THE ROLE:

AMD is seeking a candidate with subject matter expertise to join our Component Quality & Reliability team, driving component quality from concept to end of life to ensure a differentiated experience, de-risk AMD product quality, and build customer confidence. The successful candidate will be accountable for key components used on AMD products. This is a high-visibility role with interfaces across suppliers, engineering, sourcing, global operations, quality leadership, and AMD business units.

 

THE PERSON:

You are highly organized, able to prioritize and manage multiple workstreams to tight deadlines. You are a self-starter with a positive attitude and a strong desire to succeed. You bring strong communication and project management skills, with the ability to build relationships and drive effective decision-making across multiple functions and levels within a global matrix organization.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the supplier interface for key component suppliers across all AMD business units.

  • Issue Management: Lead and drive resolution of supplier quality and reliability excursions, serving as the primary interface with suppliers to drive root cause, containment, and corrective actions as needed.

  • Component Spec Management: With cross-functional team input, develop and drive supplier compliance with AMD component specification requirements, as applicable by commodity, including de-rating, electrical specifications, APQP, reliability, and outgoing DPPM quality, by production release target dates.

  • MP Readiness Review Lead: Lead mass production readiness reviews of key supplier manufacturing facilities, participating in on-site factory audits as needed.
